purpose: Implement fail-closed all-trial audit of a prospective physically timed A-before-B delayed-choice experiment without postselection. Scope is software only.

first_ci.reason: Malformed-identity synthetic control raised CLOCK_ORDER_FAIL before LATE_TRIAL_DUPLICATE; no research inference affected

data_contract.hash_rule: SHA256 of canonical JSON early list, compared to manifest
data_contract.timing_rule: late_qrng_ns > early_window_closed_ns + manifest timing margin; assumes clocks are calibrated, cannot verify physical chronology
data_contract.safety_guard: Reject unexpected late fields inside early records, duplicates, missing trials, clock-order violations, invalid bits and hash mismatches.

primary_statistic.test: One-sided exact binomial tail for precommitted early guess of later QRNG setting, across all planned trials
primary_statistic.null: Independent uniformly random fair late B, P(correct)=0.5
primary_statistic.important_limitations: Fairness and independence of hardware QRNG not verified by software; fixed sample size must be prospectively approved. Abort invalidates fixed-N inference.

secondary_statistic.test: Unconditional total variation TV(P(A including NO_CLICK|B=0), P(A including NO_CLICK|B=1))
secondary_statistic.limit: Descriptive only in R0; no preregistered significance for repeated secondary measures and no filtering on late heralds.

positive_and_negative_controls: All scheduled early outcomes retained including NO_CLICK
Artificial future-bit leakage detected as suspicious, not granted physical validity
Early log modification after manifest digest rejected
Duplicate and missing late trial IDs rejected before timing checks
Impossible or reversed timestamp ordering rejected
INFRA_ABORT retained and fixed-N significance disabled
Null data check uses deterministic pseudorandom software, not authenticated late entropy

quandela_cloud.assessment: Real photonic cloud processors are documented, but independent post-A QRNG control, raw per-attempt detector time tags, no-click record and external signed early seal are not confirmed to be offered to users. Do not assume platform sufficient for JANUS timing protocol.

ibm_quantum.assessment: Mid-circuit measurement and classical feed-forward are available on supported backends. User-level independent external time certification and QRNG choice after externally sealed A are not established by the cited documentation.

external_photonics_lab.precedent: Ma et al., Experimental delayed-choice entanglement swapping, Nature Physics 8 (2012), DOI 10.1038/nphys2294
external_photonics_lab.assessment: Four-photon time-like-future measurement decision with hardware QRNG demonstrated in literature; no present access to a lab has been obtained by JANUS.

promotion_gates.G1: NOT_MET_IN_JANUS: no independently attested physical A-before-B sequence
promotion_gates.G2: SOFTWARE_CHECK_PASS: all registered early outcomes kept, synthetic only
promotion_gates.G3: NOT_MET: no external late QRNG or leakage isolation attested
promotion_gates.G4: PARTIAL: two separate GitHub CPU versions pass; no real optical experiment or independent physical replication

next_action: Seek an authorized quantum-optics laboratory or verified cloud provider able to deliver raw per-pulse/no-click records, hardware timestamps, later QRNG setting and independent pre-choice sealing; preregister N, no-loss policy, effect thresholds and independent replication before physical run.
do_not_claim: Software data-contract tests constitute a physical experiment
Matching SHA256 in two JSON files proves pre-commit timing
Significant prediction accuracy proves retrocausality without independent entropy and leakage audit
Quantum-switch or OCB inequality violation is an operational message to the past
